headline: Meta Blocks President Lula's Facebook Page, Campaign Ads 2 Weeks from Election
summary: Meta has blocked the Facebook page and campaign ads of Brazilian President Lula just two weeks before a critical election, raising questions about platform interference.
details: Meta has taken action against Brazilian President Lula, blocking his official Facebook page and all associated campaign advertisements. This significant move occurs just two weeks before Brazil's upcoming election, a critical period for political campaigning.

The blocking raises immediate concerns about social media platforms' influence on democratic processes and election outcomes. Critics are questioning the timing and justification for such a drastic measure so close to polling day.

While Meta's content policies aim to prevent misinformation and harmful content, the specific reasons for this block have not been fully detailed. The company's decision will likely face scrutiny from international observers and political analysts.

This incident highlights the ongoing global debate regarding big tech companies' power to moderate political speech. It underscores the challenges of balancing platform integrity with freedom of expression, especially during sensitive election periods.

headline_marked: [[BetterWebSearch MCP: Open-source web search for AI agents]] needs no API key, reduces token use
headline: BetterWebSearch MCP: Open-source web search for AI agents needs no API key, reduces token use
summary: This local, open-source Model Context Protocol server offers keyless web search for AI agents using DuckDuckGo, reducing token waste by up to 86% with intelligent extraction strategies.
details: BetterWebSearch MCP is a local, open-source Model Context Protocol server designed for web search, extraction, and deep research for AI agents. It uses DuckDuckGo by default and requires no API key, account, or cloud service for its default setup.

It intelligently handles web content, progressively falling back from simple HTTP requests to structured application data and Playwright for JavaScript-heavy pages. This ensures fast processing for simple sites while supporting complex modern web apps.

The server performs search, extraction, and passage selection, returning significantly smaller research payloads to the agent. Benchmarks show up to 86% smaller payloads, saving tokens and improving efficiency.

To improve search quality, BetterWebSearch can rewrite model queries into several related searches, running them in parallel. It also clusters similar content to avoid treating duplicated stories as independent evidence, providing more accurate citations.

It includes security features like SSRF and prompt-injection protections, flagging text that attempts to manipulate an agent. The system also remembers extraction strategies for domains, optimizing future requests.

Built with an MIT license, it's designed for coding-agent and AI research workflows, supporting any MCP client that uses stdio. It avoids unnecessary intermediaries, sending queries directly to search providers and target websites.
